description: This file implements a transformation that splits array initializations into separate declaration and assignment nodes within an abstract syntax tree, used in shader code translation.

classes.name: SeparateArrayInitTraverser
classes.description: A private class that traverses the AST to identify array initializations for transformation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the transformation to the AST root node.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits declaration nodes to identify array initializations for splitting.
